pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Breeze Core controls multiple Midea air conditioners over the local network, with no cloud dependency after the initial pairing. It is a REST API, a web control panel and a diagnostic CLI in one static executable of about 2.5 MB with no runtime dependencies.
This is the prebuilt package. The binary is statically linked against musl, so it is independent of the host's libc, USE flags and CHOST.
